summary: Nyxoah SA furnished a Form 6-K on November 5, 2026, carrying its third-quarter 2026 earnings materials: a press release, a Q3 report and supplemental risk factors. Global net revenue was €9.2 million, up 19% sequentially, with U.S. net revenue of €6.7 million up 29% sequentially; the company also disclosed submission of a PMA supplement to the FDA seeking to expand its Genio indication to complete concentric collapse patients. No transaction, shareholder campaign, board change or capital event is disclosed; the filing is a routine quarterly-results update, leaving clinical and regulatory milestones as the items to watch.
